items.prompt: ORIGINAL character design for the LEFT side of a slot game screen: Seth, ancient Egyptian god of war. A tall heroic muscular man with bronze-brown skin and a handsome stern face, wearing a tall stylized jackal-like Set-animal helmet crown with two tall pointed ears, made of lapis-blue enamel and polished gold; blue and gold striped nemes flaps on the shoulders; a broad gold usekh collar with lapis and turquoise inlays; gold arm rings and engraved gold bracers; a deep blue pleated shendyt kilt with a gold belt and a hanging gold front apron; a dark navy translucent cape behind his back. POSE: standing upright in a 3/4 view, body turned toward the RIGHT side of the image. His arm on the LEFT side of the image is raised with the elbow bent outward, the open hand at head height with palm up and EMPTY (a magic flame will be added later as a separate effect). His other arm (right side of the image) hangs down relaxed, slightly away from the hip, the hand gripping a long vertical golden was-scepter staff that reaches the bottom edge. CRITICAL FOR SKELETAL RIGGING: both arms must be clearly separated from the torso with visible background gaps between each arm and the body, the face fully unobstructed, the cape outline clearly readable. Framing: from the top of the helmet ears down to the knees, figure centered with small margins, nothing cropped at the top or sides. BACKGROUND: perfectly flat solid pure green #00FF00 chroma key, no shadow, no gradient, no floor, no text, no logo.
